_about: Default email templates for account and usage notices. Generated from the textbee-admin source of truth (api/src/email-templates/defaults.json); do not edit by hand. An admin edit is stored in the emailtemplates collection and overrides these fields; a missing row means the default applies.

footers.name: Notice footer (account and usage, branded)
footers.body:
This is a notice about your textbee account. If something in it looks wrong, you can reply to this email.

[Dashboard](https://app.textbee.dev/dashboard) · [Docs](https://textbee.dev/docs)

© {{year}} textbee.dev · Nuver Labs LLC, 30 N Gould St Ste N, Sheridan, WY 82801

templates.name: Verify email
templates.subject: Confirm your email for textbee
templates.body:
# Confirm your email address

Hi,

One click confirms this address and unlocks sending.

**[Confirm my email]({{verificationUrl}})**

The link works for {{linkTtl}}. If it has expired, sign in. Your dashboard has a "Resend email" button.

If you did not create a textbee account, you can ignore this email.
templates.notes: No name in the greeting: the address is not verified yet, and bots put spam in the name field.

templates.name: Verification reminder
templates.subject: Your textbee email is not confirmed yet
templates.preheader: Sending is locked until you confirm. Here is a new link.
templates.body:
# Confirm your email to start sending

Hi,

Your textbee account is ready, but sending and receiving stay locked until you confirm this address. The earlier link has expired, so here is a new one:

**[Confirm my email]({{verificationUrl}})**

This link works for {{linkTtl}}.

If you signed up by mistake, you do not need to do anything. The account stays inactive.
templates.audience: Password signups still unverified after 24 h
templates.notes: Built as an API job that reuses the verification mint function with a 24 h link lifetime; it must not count against the 5-per-24h resend cap.

templates.name: Password reset request
templates.subject: Reset your textbee password
templates.preheader: Button or code. Both work for {{linkTtl}}.
templates.body:
# Reset your password

Hi {{firstName}},

We received a request to reset the password on your textbee account. You can choose a new one here.

**[Set a new password]({{resetUrl}})**

Or enter this code: **{{otp}}**

The button and the code work for {{linkTtl}}.

If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this email. Your password stays as it is.

templates.name: Password changed
templates.subject: Your textbee password was changed
templates.preheader: Not you? A reply to this email reaches our support team.
templates.body:
# Your password was changed

Hi {{firstName}},

Your textbee password has been changed. You can sign in with the new password now.

**Not you?** If you did not make this change, reply to this email right away. We will secure your account.

templates.name: Close to the 30-day limit
templates.subject: You are close to your 30-day limit
templates.preheader: {{used}} of {{limit}} messages used in the last 30 days.
templates.body:
# You are close to your 30-day message limit

Hi {{firstName}},

You have used {{used}} of your {{limit}} messages in the last 30 days. Sent and received messages both count. You have {{left}} left.

{{usageBar}}

The count covers a rolling 30 days, not a calendar month. Each message leaves the count 30 days after it was sent or received, so you get some room back every day.

Paid plans have a bigger 30-day allowance and no daily limit: [compare plans]({{billingUrl}})
templates.trigger: 80% of the 30-day allowance, from the send and receive path only (never page loads)

templates.name: Close to the 30-day limit (paid)
templates.subject: You are close to your 30-day limit
templates.preheader: {{used}} of {{limit}} messages used in the last 30 days.
templates.body:
# You are close to your 30-day message limit

Hi {{firstName}},

Your {{planName}} plan has used {{used}} of its {{limit}} messages in the last 30 days. You have {{left}} left, plus the extra {{headroomPercent}} we allow on paid plans.

{{usageBar}}

The count covers a rolling 30 days, not a calendar month. Each message leaves the count 30 days after it was sent or received, so you get some room back every day.

If you need more room, you can [compare plans]({{billingUrl}}), or reply to this email. We will set up a custom plan.
templates.trigger: 80% of the 30-day allowance, send and receive path only

templates.name: 30-day limit reached
templates.subject: You have used your {{limit}} messages
templates.preheader: Sending is paused. The next slot opens on {{resetDate}}.
templates.body:
# You have used your {{limit}} messages

Hi {{firstName}},

Your account has used all {{limit}} messages of its rolling 30-day allowance, so sending is paused. Sent and received messages both count.

{{usageBar}}

You do not need to do anything for sending to resume. Each message leaves the count 30 days after it was sent or received. The next slot opens on {{resetDate}}.

To keep sending now, you can [upgrade to Pro]({{upgradeUrl}}). Pro gives you {{proMonthlyLimit}} messages per rolling 30 days, no daily limit, and up to {{proDeviceLimit}} phones. It starts as soon as the payment is complete.

You will not get this email again in the next 30 days. Your dashboard shows your live count.
templates.trigger: A send or receive is blocked because the count is at the 30-day limit (not a batch that does not fit)

templates.name: 30-day limit reached (Pro)
templates.subject: You have used your {{limit}} messages
templates.preheader: Sending is paused until older messages leave the 30-day count.
templates.body:
# You have used your {{limit}} messages

Hi {{firstName}},

Your {{planName}} plan has used its {{limit}} messages for the last 30 days, plus the extra {{headroomPercent}} we allow on paid plans. Sending is paused until older messages leave the 30-day count. The next slot opens on {{resetDate}}.

{{usageBar}}

Scale gives you {{scaleMonthlyLimit}} messages and up to {{scaleDeviceLimit}} phones: [compare plans]({{billingUrl}}). If you need more than that, you can reply to this email. We will set up a custom plan.

templates.name: 30-day limit reached (Scale, custom)
templates.subject: You have used your {{limit}} messages
templates.preheader: Sending is paused until older messages leave the 30-day count.
templates.body:
# You have used your {{limit}} messages

Hi {{firstName}},

Your {{planName}} plan has used its {{limit}} messages for the last 30 days, plus the extra {{headroomPercent}} we allow on paid plans. Sending is paused until older messages leave the 30-day count. The next slot opens on {{resetDate}}.

{{usageBar}}

If you need more, you can reply to this email. We will set up a plan that fits your volume.

templates.name: Close to today's limit
templates.subject: You are close to today's limit
templates.body:
# You are close to today's message limit

Hi {{firstName}},

You have used {{used}} of your {{limit}} messages for today. Sent and received messages both count. You have {{left}} left.

{{usageBar}}

Your daily count resets at midnight UTC{{#localMidnight}} ({{localMidnight}} where you are){{/localMidnight}}.

Pro has no daily limit: [compare plans]({{billingUrl}})
templates.trigger: 80% of the daily limit, send and receive path only
templates.notes: localMidnight is set only for countries with a single time zone; otherwise the bracket is left out.

templates.name: Today's limit reached
templates.subject: Today's {{limit}} messages are used
templates.body:
# Today's {{limit}} messages are used

Hi {{firstName}},

Your account sent or received its {{limit}} messages for today. Sending is paused until midnight UTC{{#localMidnight}} ({{localMidnight}} where you are){{/localMidnight}}.

{{usageBar}}

The daily limit applies to the free plan. [Pro has no daily limit]({{upgradeUrl}}). It gives you {{proMonthlyLimit}} messages per rolling 30 days, sent whenever you need them, on up to {{proDeviceLimit}} phones.

You will get this email at most once a week. Your dashboard shows your live count.
templates.trigger: A send or receive is blocked because today's count is at the daily limit (not a batch that does not fit)
templates.cap: once per 7 days, at most 3 per 90 days

templates.name: Batch too big
templates.subject: Your batch was too big for your plan
templates.preheader: Nothing was sent. Batches of {{bulkLimit}} or fewer go through.
templates.body:
# Your batch was too big for your plan

Hi {{firstName}},

Your batch had {{attempted}} recipients, and your plan allows up to {{bulkLimit}} per batch. Nothing was sent.

You can send the same list in batches of {{bulkLimit}} or fewer. Smaller batches cost nothing extra. They also do not slow delivery, because your phone sends one message at a time.

Paid plans allow bigger batches: [compare plans]({{billingUrl}})
templates.audience: Plans with a finite batch limit
templates.trigger: A batch larger than the batch limit (checked before the daily and 30-day limits)

templates.name: One phone on the free plan
templates.subject: The free plan covers one phone
templates.preheader: Replace it, or connect up to {{proDeviceLimit}} phones on Pro.
templates.body:
# The free plan covers one phone

Hi {{firstName}},

You tried to add or turn on another phone. The free plan covers one active phone, and {{deviceName}} already uses it.

You have two options:

- Replace it: turn off {{deviceName}} on the dashboard, then register the new phone.
- Keep both: [Pro]({{upgradeUrl}}) covers up to {{proDeviceLimit}} phones. You choose which phone sends each message, so you can spread a large list across phones.
templates.trigger: Adding or enabling a phone above the device limit

templates.name: All phone slots in use (paid)
templates.subject: All your phone slots are in use
templates.preheader: Turn off a phone you no longer use, or move to a bigger plan.
templates.body:
# All your phone slots are in use

Hi {{firstName}},

Your {{planName}} plan covers {{deviceLimit}} active phones, and all of them are in use. To free a slot, turn off or remove a phone you no longer use on the dashboard.

If you need more phones, you can [compare plans]({{billingUrl}}), or reply to this email. We will set up a custom plan.
